description: This file defines the DeepSeekHandler class, which extends OpenAiHandler to facilitate communication with the DeepSeek API, including message creation, model configuration, and usage metrics processing. It handles streaming responses, reasoning content, tool calls, and integrates with Azure AI inference.

classes.name: DeepSeekHandler
classes.description: A handler class for interacting with DeepSeek API, supporting streaming chat completions with reasoning and tool call handling.

methods.name: getModel
methods.description: Retrieves model information and parameters based on current options.

methods.name: createMessage
methods.description: Creates a streaming message request to DeepSeek, supporting reasoning mode, message conversion, and error handling.

methods.name: processUsageMetrics
methods.description: Processes and formats usage metrics from DeepSeek responses, including caching details.
